content.value: Deduce an expression of acceleration head and show the effect of acceleration on velocity and pressure in a reciprocating pump.

l(c) A single acting reciprocating pump runs at 65 rpm. The diameter of the plunger is 0.2 m and crank radius is 0.18 m. The suction pipe is 10 cm in diameter and 7.5 m long. Calculate the maximum permissible value of suction lift, if the separation takes place at 2. 7 m of water absolute.
